scope: ordinary role healing through original CNpcService294, separate from inn and revival

provenance.fee_expression: client_verified original menu label level times30; exact server charging semantics designed

npc_placement.provenance: client_verified original female-doctor definition and placement; assigning service294 is designed

admission: actual current NPC service ticket and full entity key/map instance/generation/location/lease; role active, out of battle and scene transfer; no admission from NPC name alone
profile: known explicitly initialized or migrated role-resources.1 uninjured profile with strict current final equipment/growth source; missing profile rejects without initialization or full-health defaults
effect: if current HP>0, restore current HP and MP to actual final caps; keep numeric caps and exact projection source unchanged; do not alter injury status, vigor, pets, XP, durability or chapter
fee: current authoritative ordinary role level times30, positive integer; read and freeze level in the same role transaction; never accept client price/level/currency
full_resources: reject a fresh no-deficit operation without charge or receipt
dead_role: reject HP0; no revival or MP-only paid treatment of a dead role
unknown_or_injured: reject unknown baseline, pending projection source or an unsupported injury contract; do not silently migrate or clear injury
transaction: fee, one resource transition, domain/common command receipts and all final native reply encoding share the current role caller transaction; late failure rolls everything back and failed stable ID may retry
replay: same admitted stable ID and same intent is read-only and returns current full resource projection/current wallet, even after later damage or being at full resources; no second fee/heal; do not recompute a historical fee from a later level
intent: new dedicated healing receipt includes this policy, service/NPC, role/source and frozen fee/effect admission; accepted retry identity is distinct from a newly received identical wire packet
other_services: 92 requires real family authority/reputation and remains separate; 459/1957/2037 have no effect authorization from this policy; 10009 has no static placement and is not spawned; 10054 family doctor is not granted ordinary294
compatibility: add npc_heal resource cause and cash npc_role_heal purpose without rewriting resources.1/currency.1 receipts or current balances; existing inn_rest/medicine and shop behavior retain their own contracts
activation: isolated numeric and NPC implementation authorized; shared routing, deployment and GUI require independent evidence
